stories.title: Miami survives two Hail Marys, leaving FSU without answers in 2OT thriller
stories.summary: Miami withstood a pair of Hail Mary attempts from Florida State to come away with a 43-35, double-overtime win and a likely move to No. 1 in the AP Top 25.

stories.title: Big 12 admits error in Notre Dame-BYU ending, says Irish had 1 second left
stories.summary: The Big 12 said officials incorrectly ended Saturday night's game between BYU and Notre Dame and that the Irish should have had another second on the clock to run a final play.

stories.title: Sources: Saints' Shough playing with 2 broken bones in non-throwing hand
stories.summary: Saints quarterback Tyler Shough has been playing with two broken bones in his left hand, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Rays' big three busts out of slump, delivers clutch hits in series-tying win
stories.summary: Junior Caminero, Yandy Diaz and Jonathan Aranda combined to go 6-for-14 with five RBIs as the Rays tied the ALCS at 2-2 with Saturday's 7-3 win over the Guardians.

stories.title: One week after benching, Raiola rebounds to rally Ducks past former team
stories.summary: Dylan Raiola came off the bench against his former team and led Oregon to a fourth-quarter comeback victory over Nebraska.
